messages:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — cutoff for v2.7 is 2025-12-03 18:00 UTC. Can we do a final green-sweep of main+release branches today? I want to catch any flaky-tests before tagging.

Priya S: On it. I'll kick off a smoke-run on main now and list failing jobs.

ci-bot: Pipeline started: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/4872 (triggered by Priya S) :rocket:

Mateo R: If we see the intermittent transformer-masked-seq test fail again, it's usually the GPU memory jitter — rerun with ORCA_DEBUG=1 and report.

Jen L: Noted. I'll triage flakes. Attaching current flaky map in case it's useful: /docs/flaky-tests/v2.7-map.csv

Lin H: Two things — (1) remind folks to bump package.json -> version 2.7.0-rc.1 before cutoff, (2) changelog PRs should be in `changelog/ready` label.

Alex K: thanks. Also add a note to release notes about the cache eviction fix (PR #2413).

Priya S: CI results: most jobs green but `integration/gpt-kv-cache` failed on 3/5 shards with timeout 12m. Rerunning shard 4.

ci-bot: Rerun queued for job integration/gpt-kv-cache-shard-4 (requested by Priya S)

Mateo R: Quick triage — those timeouts match the known infra noise. For now, mark test with @flaky tag in test metadata so it won't block the RC cut. I'll file a follow-up to root cause.

Jen L: If we mark it flaky, we should add a temporary gating exception in the release script so the release-sheriff can override the failure if all other jobs are green.

release-sheriff: Agree. Put the exception in `release/config.json` under `soft_gates` and ping me once done. I'll approve.

Lin H: Example command to update release config:```bash
python scripts/update_release_config.py --add-soft-gate integration/gpt-kv-cache
git checkout -b rel/2.7/softgate && git commit -am "add soft gate for gpt-kv-cache flaky" && gh pr create --title "release: soft gate for flaky gpt-kv-cache" --label release
```

Alex K: tagging @release-sheriff when config PR is up. Also a reminder: cutoff includes merging only docs/changelogs and version bumps — no feature merges after cutoff.

Priya S: Shard rerun is green. Full pipeline shows 1 transient failure left (integration/long-call) — rerunning.

ci-bot: Pipeline finished: 1 failure, 29 success. Details: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/4872/builds/221

Mateo R: For the remaining `integration/long-call` failure, capture full logs and run locally with `TEST_SEED=1337` — I've seen it surface deterministically.

Jen L: I'm adding a quick changelog PR for cache eviction fix and the soft-gate config PR now. Will notify once both PRs are created.

release-sheriff: I see both PRs. Running the release checklist. If we get green except for marked soft gate, I'll approve the tag.

Alex K: Thanks team. Plan B if long-call keeps failing: cut RC with `--skip-gates` and document the known flake in release notes with a follow-up ticket.

Lin H: FYI ops: rolling canary scheduled for 2025-12-04 02:00 UTC. If you see anything off in canary dashboards, alert #eng-oncall.

Priya S: All clear from my side — merging changelog PRs now.

ci-bot: New PR merged: changelogs/2413 (merged by Priya S)

Alex K: final ask — anyone who touched serving runtime this week, please add a self-check in the release notes: test vectors, regression eval pass/fail. Saves us time during post-release smoke.

Jen L: Will do. :thumbsup:

release-sheriff: Tagging release: v2.7.0-rc.1 created by release-sheriff at 2025-12-03T18:12:30Z.

ci-bot: Release candidate build triggered: https://ci.redwood.ai/releases/2.7.0-rc.1 (status: running)

Alex K: Great work. I'll monitor the RC build and open any follow-ups. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
